tests: Delete of a file with unsaved edits asks as for any file, and its tab closes with the edits
steps:
1. Open Sources/Helpers/Util.twin and type a line; do not save.
2. Select Util.twin in Project Explorer and press Delete.
3. The box reads Are you sure you want to delete '/ProjectsProbe/Sources/Helpers/Util.twin'? You will not be able to undo this operation., as for any file. Choose Delete.
4. The file is gone and its tab closes, with the edit.
Control: renaming a file with unsaved edits is refused, naming the editor to close.
